verdict.rationale: The first-party gitleaks-action runs scans automatically on a team's pull requests and comments findings on PRs. Baseline support limits reports to new findings only, and the pre-commit hook's 'Failed' output implies a failing status when secrets are found. missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit-code semantics for failing CI builds, a documented baseline-in-CI workflow for PRs, CI integrations beyond GitHub Actions, independent hands-on corroboration.
